name: ioc-cognition-protocols
description: IoC Layer 9 Cognition Protocols — ACCORD and CONCORD multi-agent coordination skills

plugins.name: concord
plugins.description: Multi-agent consensus protocol. Converges on a single outcome that clears a satisfaction threshold for every agent in a named set. Includes both initiator (orchestrator) and receiver (participant) skills.

plugins.name: accord
plugins.description: Pre-delegation coordination protocol. Establishes shared scope, consistent terminology, and acceptance checks across specialists before any action is taken. Includes both initiator (orchestrator) and receiver (participant) skills.
